extracted.intended_audience: researchers, grant applicants, funders, and partner organizations interested in Global Grand Challenges programs
extracted.subtask_description: High-level programmatic priorities and implicit criteria used by the Grand Challenges family of initiatives to design challenges, solicit proposals, and select/foster projects that address global health and development problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus challenges on specific problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Grand Challenges initiatives use challenges to focus attention and effort on specific problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Challenges are framed as targeted requests to concentrate innovation on particular global health and development priorities; this focus is central to the initiative's design and purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use open requests for grant proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: Grand Challenges initiatives launch challenges as open requests for grant proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The open-call model is used to source innovation broadly; historically implemented via mechanisms like Grand Challenges Explorations to invite diverse applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat each challenge as an experiment in sourcing innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Each challenge is an experiment in focusing innovation on making an impact and refines the process of sourcing innovation over time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs evolve based on lessons learned (e.g., the move to Explorations and later Global Call-to-Action), indicating iterative design and willingness to adapt funding approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize impact-oriented innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Challenges focus innovation on making an impact on global health and development priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project selection and program design emphasize the potential for measurable impact and real-world application, not just conceptual novelty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster collaboration across projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Each builds a grant program that fosters collaboration across projects to speed impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs are structured to encourage cross-project interaction, knowledge-sharing, and collaboration (e.g., through annual meetings and networks) to accelerate translation and scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage innovators quickly with accessible initial grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Grand Challenges Explorations engages more of the world’s innovators more quickly through $100K initial grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of relatively small, rapid awards is a deliberate mechanism to broaden participation, lower barriers to entry, and surface promising ideas rapidly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value ideas from diverse geographic and institutional origins
rubrics_metrics.description: Evolution of the initial projects confirmed that great ideas come from everywhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program design and outreach aim to be globally inclusive; applicants from a wide range of countries and institutions are implicitly encouraged and valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support and expand a locally-led R&D ecosystem
rubrics_metrics.description: Fund cutting-edge science projects while supporting and expanding a locally-led research and development ecosystem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long-term investments are intended to strengthen local research capacity and institutional ecosystems rather than only funding external actors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure gender balance among investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: Support and expand a locally-led research and development ecosystem with a balance of women investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gender balance is an explicit program priority to ensure women investigators are represented and supported within funded portfolios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invest in platforms that link local institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Invest in platforms that link the local institutions that train and connect innovators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for funding platforms and initiatives that create durable linkages among local training, research, and innovation institutions to sustain capacity and partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directly support local people who co-create and implement programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Directly support the local people that co-create and implement global health programs, including through fellowships (e.g., Calestous Juma Science Leadership Fellowship in Africa).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic support includes fellowships and direct investment in local leaders who drive design and implementation of interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anchor partnerships around local researchers, policymakers, and funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnership initiatives anchor the work from the beginning around the local researchers, policymakers, and funders with the knowledge and perspective needed to create, guide, and accelerate transformative solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partnership-driven challenges prioritize locally-relevant leadership and stakeholder engagement from the outset to increase relevance and sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build and leverage a global network of partners
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grand Challenges family convenes a network of partners and an international network of research and funding partnerships to expand impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities like the Annual Meeting and cross-initiative collaboration are used to build momentum, share learning, and scale solutions across regions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage addressing the same problems from differing perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Each [initiative] addresses some of the same problems, but from differing perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The portfolio approach intentionally supports multiple, diverse approaches to similar problems to increase the likelihood of breakthrough solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use long-term approaches to enable transformational partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Through a long-term approach to enable transformational partnerships, invest in platforms that link local institutions and directly support local people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for sustained investments and platform-building that create conditions for transformative, durable partnerships rather than one-off projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure equitable benefit from scientific progress
rubrics_metrics.description: As the Grand Challenges family grows, the world map of awarded grants fills in and the international network of research and funding partnerships expands, helping ensure that everyone receives the full benefit of scientific progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program expansion and geographic diversification of awards are framed as mechanisms to promote equity in access to the benefits of funded science.
